title: fix: correct handling of git urls with unusual branch or subdir names
body:
Simply the logic for parsing Git URLs to ensure fragments with multiple
`#` and `:` are parsed correctly, bringing us closer to parity with
buildkit. Add tests.

Improve code comment for the Git repository URL parser to correctly
document how git URL fragments are interpreted (optional revision and
optional subdir).

Signed-off-by: Brandon Richardson <brandon.richardson@siemens.com>

These changes are completely organic, written by myself, **without** the use of AI.
